meta.description: Professional massage by appointment: Sarvanga Abhyanga, relaxing, deep tissue and detox. Hot stones and essential oils. Message me for rates and availability.

hero.subtitle: Tailored massage in my studio: skilled hands, essential oils — and, in several treatments, the warmth of hot stones — by appointment.
hero.lead: I work by appointment: message me on WhatsApp for rates, availability and to choose the best treatment together. I reply personally, with no obligation.
hero.heroImgAlt: Hot stones, essential oils and candle

philosophy.portraitAlt: Melania, professional massage therapist Healing Touch
philosophy.title: My philosophy
philosophy.subtitle: Massage as listening
philosophy.p1: I believe deeply in the healing power of touch. It is not only about releasing physical tension, but about creating a space of deep listening where body and mind can finally let go and find their natural breath again.
philosophy.p2: In my studio, every treatment is a personalised journey. I take care of you by combining skilled hands, the energy of natural elements and a quiet atmosphere where body and mind can truly slow down.
philosophy.p3: "Healing Touch" is not just a motto — it is the intention behind every gesture: a touch that welcomes, reassures and heals.

signature.title: Hot stones & essential oils
signature.subtitle: Hot stone massage with essential oils
signature.p1: The ritual where hot stones take centre stage, together with essential oils — a dedicated treatment many choose on its own or after trying other massages in the studio.
signature.p2: Basalt stones, warmed and placed on key points, slowly release their heat, easing muscle tension gently and deeply. Slow, rhythmic movements paired with the relaxing scent of the oils guide the mind into deep release.
signature.p3: A full sensory experience — ideal for deep relaxation, easing built-up stress or simply gifting yourself a moment of pure magic.

treatments.title: Treatments
treatments.intro: Every path is unique and can be adapted to your needs. Alongside classic techniques, I often use essential oils and, when the treatment calls for it, the warmth of hot stones to release tension in depth.
treatments.ctaTitle: Wondering about pricing, combining services or quick advice?
treatments.ctaBody: Message me: I will send the details and, if helpful, suggest what fits your budget and the time you have.

sarvanga.title: Sarvanga Abhyanga
sarvanga.subtitle: Ayurvedic full-body massage
sarvanga.description: Ayurvedic full-body massage from head to toe with warm medicated oils and traditional techniques. The name brings together sarva (all), anga (body) and abhyanga (oil massage).
benefits: Supports detox and immunity, helping release toxins (Ama).
Calms stress and tension with a deep effect on the nervous system.
Nourishes the skin and improves circulation and tissue tone.

relaxing.title: Relaxing massage
relaxing.subtitle: Relaxing massage
relaxing.description: Slow, enveloping strokes to ease tension and guide body and mind into quiet. Ideal after busy periods or when you need a gentle reset.
benefits: Encourages deep relaxation and more restful sleep.
Eases light stiffness in back, neck and limbs.
Restores a sense of lightness, harmony and overall wellbeing.

deep.title: Deep tissue massage
deep.subtitle: Deep tissue massage
deep.description: Deep pressure and focused work on tight areas to release adhesions and built-up tension. For stiffness, exertion-related discomfort or long hours at a desk.
benefits: Releases muscle knots and improves joint mobility.
Relieves tension from desk work, sport or repetitive strain.
Helps you feel freer and more open in your body.

detox.title: Detox massage
detox.subtitle: Detox & circulation massage
detox.description: Rhythmic, deep work (not classic lymphatic drainage) to reawaken circulation and support a feeling of lightness and renewal.
benefits: Stimulates circulation and tissue metabolism in depth.
Supports toxin release with an energising yet calm effect.
Leaves the whole body feeling lighter and more vital.
